description: A plant safety officer must decide whether to authorize a trial run of a solvent-recovery skid and finalize the permitted batch size, equipment preparation, ventilation, monitoring, and waste-handling controls, with input from process engineering, maintenance, and environmental compliance.

shared_context.S1: The plant has installed a solvent-recovery skid beside the coating area, but it has not yet been used on production solvent.
shared_context.S2: Nine hundred liters of solvent mixture are stored in labeled drums awaiting a disposition decision.
shared_context.S3: The standard pre-job procedure requires an equipment inspection, closed transfer, ventilation verification, vapor monitoring, and documented waste handling before solvent recovery begins.
shared_context.S4: Mara makes the final authorization decision.
shared_context.S5: Plant policy requires Mara to conduct a pre-job review with process engineering, maintenance, and environmental compliance before authorizing the trial.

PF1.text: Jonas's bench compatibility test found that only 600 liters of the stored mixture is suitable for this skid; the remaining 300 liters contains a solvent component that the skid's seals are not rated for. He completed the test yesterday, but the result is still in his lab notebook and has not been uploaded to the process file.

PF2.text: Priya's pre-use inspection found that the skid transfer pump seal must be replaced and pressure-tested before operation; the replacement takes exactly 3 hours, and the seal kit is in the maintenance storeroom. She recorded the finding on a paper inspection sheet that has not yet been entered in the electronic work-order system.

PF3.text: Caleb's permit review confirmed that this solvent recovery requires ventilation of at least 6 air changes per hour, exactly 2 continuously operating LEL monitors, and a hazardous-waste manifest for the incompatible 300 liters. He received the permitting clarification from the environmental office this morning but has not filed it with the trial paperwork.

acceptance_conditions: The trial must either be authorized for exactly 600 liters or remain unauthorized with a commitment explicitly limiting any future authorization to 600 liters.
The transfer-pump seal must either be replaced or have a commitment targeting Priya that requires pump-seal replacement and pressure testing before authorization.
The pump replacement and pressure test must receive exactly 3 hours of downtime.
Ventilation must be set to at least 6 air changes per hour.
Exactly 2 continuously operating LEL monitors must be assigned.
The incompatible 300 liters must either be manifested or have a commitment targeting Caleb that requires a hazardous-waste manifest for the 300 liters before the trial begins.
A commitment must document the pump pressure test.
The environmental permitting clarification must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C1: (decisions['recovery_authorized'] == True and decisions['authorized_recovery_volume_liters'] == 600) or (decisions['recovery_authorized'] == False and (decisions['authorized_recovery_volume_liters'] == 600 or any('600' in c['detail'] and ('trial' in c['detail'] or 'authorize' in c['detail'] or 'authorization' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)))
content_checks.C2: decisions['authorized_recovery_volume_liters'] == 600 or (decisions['recovery_authorized'] == False and any('600' in c['detail'] and ('trial' in c['detail'] or 'authorize' in c['detail'] or 'authorization' in c['detail']) for c in commitments))
content_checks.C3: decisions['pump_seal_replaced'] == True or any(c['target'] == 'Priya' and ('pump seal' in c['detail'] or 'transfer pump seal' in c['detail']) and ('replace' in c['detail'] or 'replacement' in c['detail']) and ('pressure test' in c['detail'] or 'pressure-test' in c['detail'] or 'pressure-tested' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: decisions['incompatible_solvent_manifested'] == True or any(c['target'] == 'Caleb' and '300' in c['detail'] and ('manifest' in c['detail'] or 'permit review' in c['detail'] or 'permit clarification' in c['detail'] or 'permit requirements' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['target'] == 'Priya' and ('pressure test' in c['detail'] or 'pressure-test' in c['detail'] or 'pressure-tested' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The compatibility test changes the permitted recovery quantity from the full 900 liters to exactly 600 liters and requires any authorization scope to exclude the incompatible 300 liters.
The inspection changes the equipment plan to a required pump-seal replacement, exactly 3 hours of downtime, and a documented pressure-test commitment.

The permit clarification changes the controls to at least 6 air changes per hour, exactly 2 LEL monitors, a hazardous-waste manifest for the 300 incompatible liters, and explicit citation of that clarification.
